note: Truncated SHA-256 hashes of words taken from reference-site domains and owner names. Stored as hashes so the repo does not contain those identifiers. Demo text must not contain any word whose hash is listed.
namesNote: Truncated SHA-256 of normalised reference-site names and host labels (lowercase a-z0-9, 5+ characters). The plaintext list stays outside the repository. Common dictionary words that happen to be host labels are excluded.
